svg.title: P003 · Customers in metro cities
svg.desc: One row per customer in an eligible metro. ID 5 displays MUMBAI and matches on mumbai. Padding disappears from ID 12. Pune (ID 21) drops out. Bangalore, Bombay and New Delhi are accepted spellings in this exercise. Within Bengaluru, ID 7 precedes ID 12. The output keeps each trimmed display spelling.
svg.text: One row per customer in an eligible metro.
Two customers have Bengaluru with different spacing. How will their names be ordered?
A triangle marks an example to follow. Shaded columns show what to read. Dots inside quotes show padding. SQL excerpts use … for omitted
Which city spelling is shown and which is tested?
ID 5 displays MUMBAI and matches on mumbai. Padding disappears from ID 12.
Which customers match the metro list?
Pune (ID 21) drops out. Bangalore, Bombay and New Delhi are accepted spellings in this exercise.
How do two people in the same city break a tie?
Within Bengaluru, ID 7 precedes ID 12. The output keeps each trimmed display spelling.
